title: Parser token, format 1 (PARSER.md section 1)
description: One element of app.sentence.tokens / snapshot sentence.tokens / API SentenceToken / worker parse response tokens. Producer schema: closed, all ten members present. Readers ignore unknown members. Cross-token rules (ordering, surface = text slice, gaps) are in PARSER.md 1.2 and checked by check_parser.py, not here.

s.description: Start, UTF-16 code units into the ORIGINAL sentence text, inclusive.

reading.description: Hiragana reading of the surface (no katakana U+30A1-U+30F6); may be empty for override tokens.

pos.description: Sudachi POS levels 1-4 with '*' removed; empty only for override tokens.

cform.description: Sudachi conjugation form verbatim (e.g. 連用形-一般); null if it does not inflect.

override.description: true iff produced by a parse override.
